text: 🔥🇲🇽 Sheinbaum, speaking from the Monument to the Revolution, named it directly: "The 2006 electoral fraud brought the spurious Felipe Calderón to power. He filled this country with death — through a failed war on drugs in which the alliance with a drug cartel was amply demonstrated. That was the narco-government." "And let's not forget Operation Fast and Furious — the pact that let thousands of U.S. high-powered weapons enter our country." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo When the U.S. press lectures Mexico about cartels, this is the history they erase.

🇲🇽✊ Sheinbaum closed her two-year anniversary speech with a call to mobilize: "Starting next week — go to the public plazas. Hold assemblies. Hand out flyers and newspapers. Tell the people: the homeland is not for sale. It is loved and defended." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo The 4T does not retreat into palaces when pressured. It goes back to the streets.

🇲🇽🌎 Sheinbaum at the Monument to the Revolution, marking two years since her victory: "We collaborate. We coordinate. But we never subordinate ourselves — and we never will. The fathers and mothers of this homeland paid a heavy price for our sovereignty." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo A direct response to Washington after the April 19 incident — when two unaccredited U.S. agents died in Chihuahua while operating without authorization on Mexican soil.

🚨🇲🇽 "Mexico is nobody's piñata." "When from abroad they dictate who is guilty and who isn't, when they pressure our institutions from outside, when they normalize the idea that another country can intervene in matters that belong only to Mexicans — that's not cooperation. That's interference." — Claudia Sheinbaum, two-year anniversary speech, Monument to the Revolution The line came after the U.S. Department of Justice requested the urgent extradition of 10 Mexican citizens — including a sitting governor, a mayor, and a senator — without presenting public evidence.

🇲🇽🌎 UNAM: WORLD CUP 2026 WILL SUPERCHARGE RENTS AND INEQUALITY IN HOST CITIES

UNAM researchers in the colloquium "The City as a Global Showcase" warn the 2026 World Cup will spike rents and deepen urban inequality across CDMX, Guadalajara and Monterrey — and barely retreat once the tournament ends. Per-square-meter prices are already exploding in Coyoacán and Tlalpan near Estadio Azteca. In Monterrey, June inventory has dried up, pushing families to the periphery away from work centers. Around Akron Stadium in Guadalajara, fixed-rental housing is being wholesale-converted to furnished suites at peak-season prices. FIFA's "global showcase" runs the same script every cycle — Qatar, Russia, Brazil. The Brugada–Sheinbaum rent reforms are the only counterforce prior host cities didn't have.

🇲🇽🌎 XOCHIMILCO SHUTS DOWN ILLEGAL WASTEWATER DISCHARGES — PRE-HISPANIC CANAL SYSTEM DEFENDED

CDMX government, SEDEMA, SEGIAGUA and the Xochimilco municipality coordinated to physically block illegal sewage conduits dumping into the canals — sanctioning four commercial establishments running unpermitted sanitary services. Two of the analyzed discharge points contained hazardous contaminants. The Xochimilco lacustrine ecosystem is the only one of its kind on Earth — endemic species, the pre-Hispanic chinampa system still functioning after five centuries. Brugada's CDMX treats Xochimilco like the patrimony it is, not the open sewer the neoliberal decades turned it into.

🇲🇽🌎 SHEINBAUM: "THE RIGHT TO TRUTH IS A PEOPLE'S RIGHT — YOU CANNOT LIE TO MEXICO DAILY"

Sheinbaum confronted the foreign-orchestrated media campaigns frontally: "El derecho a la verdad es un derecho del pueblo en México y no se le puede mentir a diario." She framed Hondurasgate — the documented plan to destabilize her and Petro — as just one node in coordinated disinformation networks run by "those who want to return to power for their benefit, not the people's." Cited Kapuściński, Ramonet, and Chomsky on media transformed into commodity for market interests. They ran this exact playbook against AMLO for six years. It didn't work then.

🚨🇲🇽 CNTE TEACHERS ENTER DAY THREE BLOCKING CDMX — DEMAND REPEAL OF CALDERÓN-ERA PENSION LAW

150 teachers from Oaxaca's Sección 22 CNTE entering their third day blocking Centro Histórico — demanding repeal of the 2007 ISSSTE Law (the Calderón-era neoliberal pension theft), a 100% wage increase, and deeper systemic reform. Sección 22 simultaneously occupying the Ciudad Judicial complex back in Oaxaca. Segob has called for dialogue and offered working tables, citing impact on millions of citizens and the World Cup six weeks out. The pension robbery from the neoliberal years is the open wound the 4T inherited and hasn't yet closed.

🇲🇽🌎 EDGAR MORIN, ARCHITECT OF "COMPLEX THOUGHT," DIES AT 104

Edgar Morin — Jewish son of Salonika refugees, French Resistance fighter, six-decade architect of "complex thought," lifelong critic of Israeli occupation — has died at 104. La Jornada notes he influenced "generations of researchers, teachers and students around the world" and kept publishing past 100. His entire project was the opposite of how Western academia operates: refuse to fragment knowledge into disciplinary boxes, refuse to separate science from politics from culture from history. One of the few European public intellectuals who consistently named Gaza a genocide.

🚨🇲🇽 CUAUTLA MAYOR CAPTURED — PAN POLITICIAN PAID BY SINALOA CARTEL TO FUND CAMPAIGN

PAN mayor Jesús Corona Damián of Cuautla, Morelos was captured in Acapulco's Costa Azul neighborhood after days as a fugitive — caught carrying a pistol — for taking Sinaloa Cartel money to fund his electoral campaign in exchange for protecting their operations across the state. Harfuch confirmed the arrest as part of Operativo Enjambre, which has now taken down 85+ officials and 7 sitting mayors. He was filmed meeting with "El Barbas" of the cartel. The PAN keeps insisting Morena is the "narco-party" — meanwhile their own alcaldes get cuffed one by one.
